headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins fell to the Cleveland Guardians in a 5-2 loss, led by Ryan Jeffers' home run and RBI. The Los Angeles Dodgers edged the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Justin Wrobleski earning the win. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays 12-2, with Nick Fortes contributing a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Toronto Blue Jays placed LF Jonatan Clase on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis. The Baltimore Orioles have Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. The Athletics have J.T. Ginn on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. The Kansas City Royals have transferred Stephen Kolek to the 60-day injured list with a right flexor strain and placed Bobby Witt Jr. on the 10-day injured list with low back tightness. The Arizona Diamondbacks have Drey Jameson on the 15-day injured list with right hip inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have Jack Flaherty on the 15-day injured list with right flexor inflammation. The Texas Rangers have Jose Corniell on the 15-day injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Kansas City Royals traded RF Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 5-2 defeat at the hands of the Cleveland Guardians. Ryan Jeffers led the Twins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Edge Phillies in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers took down the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Justin Wrobleski earning the win.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Blue Jays 12-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. Nick Fortes led the Rays' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Braves 8-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, led by a dominant performance from their offense. Manny Machado led the charge with two home runs and two RBIs in five at-bats.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, snapping their winning streak. Jake Mangum, Nick Gonzales, Jacob Gonzalez, and Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense, while Mitch Keller pitched a strong game.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Impact hitters for the Orioles included Pete Alonso, Christian Encarnacion-Strand, Jackson Holliday, and Ceddanne Rafaela.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Clase Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left fielder Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis, effective retroactive to July 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
